evals.name: arxiv-flashattention-result
evals.prompt: Read https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.14135 and tell me what FlashAttention's main contribution is. Cite specific results.
evals.expected_output: Inline citations with §/page or Table/Fig+page locators, real bib pulled, no fabricated numbers. Should produce ~/papers/dao2022-flashattention.../ with paper.pdf, source/, citation.bib, meta.json, notes.md.

evals.name: title-only-gpt3-bibtex
evals.prompt: I want to cite the GPT-3 paper (Brown et al., 'Language Models are Few-Shot Learners') in my notes. Pull it and give me the right bibtex plus a one-paragraph summary that I can quote with proper page references.
evals.expected_output: Real bibtex from authoritative source (Semantic Scholar / Crossref / arXiv API). Summary with inline (Author Year, §X, p.N) locators. No fabricated bib fields.

evals.name: adversarial-from-memory
evals.prompt: What's the most important finding in the 2017 'Attention Is All You Need' paper? I need this for a slide deck with proper citations.
evals.expected_output: Skill should fetch the paper first, then cite the specific BLEU result with table+page (e.g. Table 2, p.8) rather than vague '(Vaswani et al. 2017)'. Baseline will likely answer from memory with hand-wavy citations, that is what we're trying to beat.
